ladder.label: UNCONFIRMED TURN
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup is forming (swing low in, momentum turned up) — but the higher timeframes haven't confirmed it: the bigger picture is still bearish (weekly momentum negative; investor cycle overdue). This is an UNCONFIRMED TURN, not a confirmed buy. Weekly confirmation lags price, so this exact reading covers BOTH bounces that fail AND the first leg of a genuine new cycle — you can't tell which in real time, so treat it as a risk/size signal, not a direction call. Measured: weekly-unconfirmed bottoming setups held the low ~49% of the time vs ~68% once the weekly turns up.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 126.86. Not an investment buy yet. What would upgrade it: weekly momentum turning up, a reclaim of the investor-cycle low, or the first daily cycle right-translating — add on confirmation, not ahead of it.

ladder.why_zh: 正在形成日线筑底形态（摆动低点已现、动量转向上行）——但更高周期尚未确认：大局仍偏空（周线动量为负；投资者周期已逾期）。这是「未确认转向」，并非已确认的买入。周线确认滞后于价格，因此同样的读数既涵盖最终失败的反弹，也涵盖真正新周期的第一段——实时无法判定属于哪一种，故应将其视为风险/仓位信号，而非方向判断。实测：周线未确认的筑底形态约 49% 守住低点，周线转向后升至约 68%。

ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

timing.next_trigger: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 126.86. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.

headline.en: Short-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime → rate tailwind.
headline.zh: 短久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境→利率顺风。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta -0.32 ± 0.23 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLF) reads short-duration (-0.11). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta -0.32 ± 0.23——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLF）为短久期（-0.11）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

caveat.en: Public-record alt-data convergence — the unusual-activity layer. Graded vs SPY in the Signal Intelligence ledger; weight by that track record, not a standalone trade signal.
caveat.zh: 公开记录替代数据汇聚——异常活动层。在信号情报战绩中对标普评分；据该战绩权衡，而非独立交易信号。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 126.86. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
timing.text_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 126.86 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

trend.label: Trend
trend.value_zh: 下行 · 较200日均线 -10% · 逆势
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

valuation.label: Valuation
valuation.gloss: Cheap/rich vs the market — context, not a buy signal.
valuation.gloss_zh: 相对大盘的估值——参考，非买入信号。

quality.label: Quality
quality.gloss: Accounting flags — verify before trusting the numbers.
quality.gloss_zh: 财务质量警示——核实后再信赖数据。

positioning.label: Positioning
positioning.value_zh: 内部人卖出 · 做空 6% 流通
positioning.gloss: Insider buying (an edge) and short interest (a risk).
positioning.gloss_zh: 内部人买入（优势）与做空比例（风险）。

squeeze.label: Vol squeeze
squeeze.gloss: Compression → a move is loading; direction unconfirmed until it breaks.
squeeze.gloss_zh: 波动压缩——更大行情正在蓄势；突破前方向未定。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -9% · 极端 -21% · → 建议仓位 25%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
